jquants_retail.japanese_stock_intraday: One-minute unadjusted OHLC, shares volume and yen turnover for TSE-listed cash equities; may aggregate observed minute bars into 5-minute bars, but must predefine session/auction/no-trade handling.
jquants_retail.coverage: TSE ordinary shares plus ETF/ETN/REIT/TSE foreign shares. No regional-exchange-only stocks, PTS, futures/options/index minute data. Delisted history included within retention while listed.
jquants_retail.history: 2 years for minute/tick add-on, independent of longer daily-data base plan history; newly listed issues only since TSE listing.
jquants_retail.availability: Daily about16:30JST; not a live minute feed, no guaranteed exact update time and no data-available-at per observation.
jquants_retail.access: API key and paid Light/Standard/Premium base plan plus minute/tick add-on; CSV download also documented; no use/account/contract attempted.
jquants_retail.published_price: Current homepage: Light1,650JPY/month; stock-minute/tick add-on5,500JPY/month. Displayed monthly sum7,150JPY. No price inferred for corporate licensing or existing user terms.
jquants_retail.rate: Minute/tick add-on60requests/min, account-wide; multiple keys do not multiply limits. Official429 guidance wait>=1minute (about2minutes forcertainty); no requests were made to the priceAPI.
jquants_retail.license_cloud: Personal private use only; third-party raw-data sharing prohibited. Cloud storage allowed only when solely the individual can view it and access is controlled. Delete originals, copies and reconstructable derivatives after cancellation/downgrade.
jquants_retail.limitations: Official page states no-trade minutes are omitted; 09:00 opening bar is not guaranteed, 11:30/15:30 auctions may create equal-OHLC bars, generally15:24 then15:30. Data may be corrected without supplying previous versions.
